about_the_game:
Orbital Arena is an Incremental Rogue-Lite Game that is exactly the PERFECT difficulty. You have the ability to adjust your stats, your enemies stats, and even your enemy count. All of which reflect back to how many resources you acquire during the game.

 

Sit down for 5+ Hours of fun, with a custom-made sound track, that you can customize yourself!

Control your ship with “Tank-Like” controls to out-perform your enemies in a 1(You)  vs [Insert Number Here] (The Enemies) Arena style combat. Shoot your Opponents before they reach you to achieve victory! Utilize your Shield to take advantage of Invincibility and dominate, but be careful, Your shield is only as reliable as you can make it.

Level-Up your ship to allow for more Mobility, Damage, Health, or Shield.

Level-Up your Enemies for more Resources and more Challenges.

Increase the Enemies for more difficulty!
